Messages.Author: Joshua Duffin
Messages.Body:
This came up in a thread here a week or so ago but didn't
get answered in that thread, that I saw.

Can a Slaughterhouse be used during another player's turn
in between, for example, before-range cards that the acting
player is playing? I thought no, because as long as the
active player has effects she wants to use, no one else can
use effects until she's done. [1.6.1.6]

(My last post from the thread where the issue came up was
on 5-Apr-2002 if you want to look at it.)

thanks,

Josh

> active player has effects she wants to use, no one else can
> use effects until she's done. [1.6.1.6]

Right. If the acting player is "done" playing pre-range stuff
and someone then taps the Slaughterhouse, the opportunity to
play more pre-range stuff again passes to the acting Meth,
though, per 1.6.1.6.

> (My last post from the thread where the issue came up was
> on 5-Apr-2002 if you want to look at it.)

I didn't see it, sorry.
